name: search_android_code
description: Search for code in Android source repositories (cs.android.com). Returns matching files and code snippets.

contextLines.description: Number of context lines around matches (default: 1)

pageSize.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

project.description: Filter by project: android, androidx, android-studio, android-llvm

query.description: Search query. Supports regex and special operators like file:, class:, function:, etc.
